notes: The Ledger reply-box router (#884): one universal reply on a feed card, routed by the model instead of per-card verb menus. Six intents — research (dig in) / save (keep for later) / worldview (a durable belief about HOW I invest) / dismiss (drop/done/irrelevant) / question (converse) / note (additive context, no routing). A wrong intent routes the reply to the wrong action; question is the fail-open bucket, so the observation/question and note/question boundaries are the ones this set guards. Every enum value appears >= 2x. Exact-match intent, no partial credit.
